- **No 2027 rate on file:** I couldn't find an agreed 2027 rate. The only signed per-seat rate is in the 2026 renewal order form, and that term ends 31 Jan 2027.
- **What I did:** I logged an approval request naming June and sent her a direct message. I asked whether a figure can go to Tobias and, if so, which one. I replied to Ilse in her direct message to explain this, without quoting any figure.

I'll draft the mail once June or Anselm approves and confirms the figure.
